mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user_post where user_id = #{userId} and department_id = #{orgDeptId}

select distinct sup.company_id as orgId, c.`name` as name, c.`type` as type, ifnull(cei.abbreviation,'公司') as abbreviation from sys_user_post sup left join company c on sup.company_id = c.id left join clinic_ext_info cei on sup.company_id = cei.company_id where sup.user_id = #{userId}

select sup.id, sup.company_id as orgId, sup.department_id as orgDeptId, d.`name` as deptName, sup.post_id as postId, sup.group_id as postGroupId, c.`name` as name, c.`type` as type, ifnull( cei.abbreviation, '公司' ) as abbreviation from sys_user_post sup left join ( select cp.id, d.`name` from company_department cp left join department d on cp.department_id = d.id ) d on sup.department_id = d.id left join company c on sup.company_id = c.id left join clinic_ext_info cei on sup.company_id = cei.company_id where sup.user_id = #{userId}

select distinct sup.post_id as id, p.`name`, sup.group_id as postGroupId, pg.`name` as postGroupName from sys_user_post sup left join post p ON sup.post_id = p.id left join post_group pg on sup.group_id = pg.id where sup.company_id = #{orgId} and sup.user_id = #{userId}
